faq.q: How much does Scott Cerbin Criminal Defense charge?
faq.a: Scott Cerbin Criminal Defense publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Are the case results Scott Cerbin Criminal Defense publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Scott Cerbin Criminal Defense publishes 31 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
